status_summary: HUD has unwound several climate-related measures since 2025. A notice published 2025-06-26 ended the reduced green and energy-efficient premium category for Section 232 healthcare loans effective 2025-08-25, and a notice published 2025-09-23 set a single 0.25 percent premium for FHA multifamily programs and removed the 2016 premium categories for applications from 2025-10-01. After a 2025-07-07 request for comment and a 2026-03-05 federal court vacatur of the 2024 energy code determination, HUD and USDA rescinded the 2024 energy code determination for HUD- and USDA-financed new construction in a notice published 2026-05-01, following Executive Order 14394 (published 2026-03-18), which directed reform of such energy requirements. Notice H 2026-01 (issued 2026-01-26) restructured the Green and Resilient Retrofit Program and ended new funding for solar panels and EV chargers from 2026-03-01, and a proposed rule published 2026-07-10 would rescind most of the 2024 floodplain rule, with comments due 2026-09-08.

timeline.event: HUD published a notice ending the green and energy-efficient premium category for Section 232 mortgages, effective for applications received on or after 2025-08-25.
HUD and USDA published a notice seeking comment on revisiting adoption of the 2021 IECC and ASHRAE 90.1-2019 energy codes.
HUD finalized a single 0.25 percent premium for FHA multifamily programs and removed the 2016 premium rate categories, for applications from 2025-10-01.
HUD issued Notice H 2026-01 restructuring the Green and Resilient Retrofit Program, effective 2026-03-01.

In State of Utah v. Secretary of HUD (E.D. Tex.), brought by 15 states and the National Association of Home Builders, the court denies the agencies' motion to dismiss and grants summary judgment in part, setting aside and vacating the 2024 energy efficiency Final Determination for HUD- and USDA-financed housing; the 2026-05-01 rescission notice recites this decision as a basis.
timeline.source: Federal Register (HUD and USDA notice, 91 FR 23450)

timeline.event: Executive Order 14394 was published, directing HUD, USDA, DOE and FHFA to reform energy-efficiency and related requirements for housing.
HUD and USDA published a notice rescinding the 2024 final determination adopting energy efficiency standards for new HUD- and USDA-financed housing, effective the same day.
HUD proposed rescinding most of the 2024 floodplain management and wetlands rule, including its climate-informed science approach.
